name: Collage
guessed: the build is an abstract collage: a flat 3x3 lime glazed terracotta ring with a lime concrete centre and four lime concrete tabs, plus a yellow concrete block and a blue glazed terracotta cube
lime concrete and lime glazed terracotta taken from the wiki reskin notes (black concrete in place of lime concrete, black glazed terracotta in place of lime glazed terracotta)
yellow block read as 2x1x2 yellow concrete and blue cube as 2x2x2 blue glazed terracotta; exact sizes estimated from perspective
floor patches read as sponge (front-left) and cyan concrete (right); both colours are ambiguous under the render lighting
the glazed ring may in the real build be a full 3x3 plate with the lime centre covered; hidden faces assumed
